Document.p: Freight warehouses collect and store food, coal, goods, ore and steel. They are available at zero technology and cost $6 a day to run.

Connect the warehouse edge to a track, road or railway. It can dispatch freight to facilities up to 48 connected transport tiles away. Road and rail can both serve the same warehouse, so it can bridge a rail corridor and a local road network.

A connected warehouse can collect surplus from a mine, supply a market on a different street and feed a connected pottery or steel works. Routes share the capacity of their transport tiles. Upgrade busy freight corridors when a track cannot keep up.
